description: Arena FM: match commentary. WHEN: read a match's Arena FM commentary: every line with its voice, persona, and the event id that triggered it, in emission order — the same lines a replay plays back. Bots hear only what the log said. Works for live broadcasts fed to the FM director and for finished matches (derived on first read from the D1 finished-match record). Read-only, 0 credits, no key needed. Example: match_commentary {"match_id":"<match_id>"}
